# Decode URL

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Converts URL encoded text to normal characters.

## Syntax

~~~~text
decodeURL(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
decodeURL(url: "Hello%20World")
~~~~
